hero.description: Ekar kōmman jān modern decentralized teknolji. Ejjelok central server. Ejjelok juon wōt point eo emaron jorrāān.

about.title: Kōn
about.intro: {project} ej juon platform ekāāl ñan peer-to-peer aje pinep̧einin bok ko, ekar kōmman jān modern decentralized teknolji. Ej kōppopo juon interface epidodo im juon architecture eo eaolep decentralized, eo ej kōmmane bwe aje bok ko en jab uwota im emaron lokjak ejjelok aikuj an juon central authority. Project in ej open source, eḷap an kommanmane iuṃwin {license}.

decentralized.title: Network eo eaolep decentralized
decentralized.description: Ejjelok central server, ejjelok juon wōt point eo emaron jorrāān. Ri-kōjerbal ro rej lo im tōl-laḷḷok content jān doon, im rej jab pedped ioon juon central index, tracker, ak database.

accessControl.title: Lale eo elap an deḷọñ
accessControl.description: Jabdewōt armej emaron kalōke an make network kōn an make kien ko ejjelok wōnāer. Ilo jabdewōt network, role ko an ri-kōjerbal raar definelok: ri-jolet, administrator, ri-kowaḷok, moderator, im ri-ḷoor. Eor aṃ lale eo elap an deḷọñ kōn wōn emaron kowaḷok, moderate, im tōl-laḷḷok content.

ui.title: Interface eo eṃṃan an kōjerbal
ui.description: Juon interface emelele im erre-wōt an media center, ekar kōmmane ñan desktop, televisor, im platform mobile ko. Epidodo an iuṃwin keyboard, ratona, gamepad, ak juon control remote. Ri-kōjerbal ro reaolep emaron kōjerbal software in āinwōt juon headless data server kōn command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Data format eo armej emaron kōnono
dataFormat.description: Data format eo LISH ekar kōmmane ioon JSON, eo ej kōmmane bwe enaaj epidodo an kōmmane, kōnono, im meḷeḷe. Ajete content eo aṃ kōn metadata eḷḷap im erre-wōt, eo jabdewōt armej emaron kanooj lale.

security.title: Tutu im kōjparok
security.description: Aolep kōnono peer-to-peer encrypted, eo ej kōmmane bwe data ko aṃ ren tutu ilo transit. Ri-kōjerbal ro remaron tilekek ālikin VPN ñan eḷḷap anonymity. {project} ej koutiej an aṃ tutu kōn an design.

crossPlatform.title: Iioon platform ko relōñ
crossPlatform.description: Software in eor an Windows, Linux, im macOS. Kōjerbal e ioon jabdewōt platform eo aṃ kōnaan.

download.title: Tōl-laḷḷok
download.description: Bōk {project} ñan platform eo aṃ. Aolep tōl-laḷḷok ko rej ejjelok wōnāer im open source.
